import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/meta-regression_joined_data_heterogeneity_in_replication_projects.csv')

# Filter the dataset for Experimental Economics
experimental_economics_data = df[df['discipline'] == 'Experimental Economics']

# Calculate the average number of authors for original studies
average_n_authors_o = experimental_economics_data['n_authors.o'].mean()

# Calculate the average number of authors for replication studies
average_n_authors_r = experimental_economics_data['n_authors.r'].mean()

average_n_authors_o, average_n_authors_r

import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
